question_or_proposition: In the Outfall 001 limitations table row for Dissolved Copper, what permitting obligation do the 'Report' entries in the mg/l discharge limitation columns (30-Day Average and Daily Maximum) establish—specifically, whether they indicate that no enforceable numeric effluent limit applies (so measurements are not subject to numeric exceedance comparison) while the 1/Week Grab monitoring columns separately establish a required sampling and reporting obligation?
required_context: Table column headers distinguishing discharge limitations (lbs/day and mg/l, 30-Day Average and Daily Maximum) from monitoring requirements (measurement frequency and sample type)

Adjacent pollutant rows for contrast, especially Total Copper (numeric 0.011 mg/l limits with 1/Week Grab monitoring) versus Dissolved Copper (Report in mg/l limitation columns with 1/Week Grab monitoring)
Introductory authorization text requiring discharges from Outfall 001 to be limited and monitored as specified in the table
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, page 3, section part_i, Outfalls 001 limitations table (Dissolved Copper row)
notes: The nominated row pairs 'Report' in mg/l limitation cells with explicit 1/Week Grab monitoring. Resolving how 'Report' functions in the limitation columns versus the monitoring columns affects whether Purpose A treats dissolved copper measurements as subject to numeric limit comparison, and whether Purpose C classifies missing dissolved copper data as absent required monitoring versus a no-numeric-comparison reporting context.
